newsitem.title: CYPRUS: British detectives to stay in custody in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: British detectives to stay in custody in Cyprus.

text.p: Two British detectives charged with stealing pharmaceutical import documents from a clearing agency in Cyprus last month will stay in custody until their trial in June, a court ruled on Wednesday.

The court in the southern coastal town of Limassol rejected a bail plea by lawyers for Paul Whylbron, 47, and Andrew Flack, 53. They are due to stand trial at the criminal court on June 5 on charges of burglary and conspiracy to commit a crime.
The two have denied the charges, related to the theft of about 2,000 documents connected with the import of raw materials for local pharmaceutical firms.
Police allege the documents were found in the suspects' possession when they were arrested last month. They were detained just before take-off on a plane bound for London.
